questions: Did the tremor begin before you were 40 years old?
Have you ever had liver disease, jaundice, abnormal liver tests, or unexplained abdominal swelling?
Have you noticed personality change, depression, irritability, impulsiveness, or other unexplained psychiatric symptoms?
Have you developed slowness, stiffness, abnormal postures, difficulty speaking, difficulty swallowing, or problems with balance?
Have you ever been told that you have a brown or greenish ring around the edge of your cornea?
Does the tremor occur when your arms are completely relaxed and resting?
Is the tremor present in both arms?
Did the tremor begin suddenly over hours or days?
Does the tremor occur only when maintaining a posture or performing an action?
Does alcohol temporarily reduce the tremor?
Does anyone in your family have a similar tremor or another movement disorder?
Have you taken medications such as lithium, valproate, antipsychotics, stimulants, asthma medicines, or drugs for nausea?
Have you had excessive thyroid symptoms such as unexplained weight loss, heat intolerance, palpitations, or diarrhea?
Do you have tremor of your head, voice, legs, or jaw?
Does the tremor interfere with writing, eating, drinking, or other skilled tasks?
Do you have difficulty coordinating your movements or reaching accurately?
Have you had a significant head injury, stroke, brain infection, or exposure to toxic substances?
Did the tremor begin in one specific task or posture and later spread to other situations?
